item.content:encoded: I like this one; feels like it should have some kind of connection to Three Portlands, so potential is there. The Nibbling Incident is amusing, but at the very least should have had the item moved to secure storage. Also, I agree that some reference to the missing crayons is in order, if only to see if the missing-ness (or the brokenness of the one that is broken) is reflective of the people or just affects the ability to pull thoughts from the relevant people. Best way I can think of offhand is to have the break having happened since the anomaly was discovered, with either an event affecting the relevant person noted thereafter, or not. Personally, I would go for "noted", and likewise after the "nibbling incident", which makes these a lot creepier- a whole circle of people's lives tied to the survival of a set of crayons. Also makes the worn down one more interesting.

Yeah, I don't really get that. A majority of those I've seen so far have no business being contained in an office vs a secure storage locker. Require a checkout form be submitted to the particular researcher (it's a limited use thing, so having it restricted in that way kinda makes sense so it isn't all used up frivolously).

I was actually hoping for something more from the broken one. Feels like a Chekov's Crayon, but there's no payoff. Unless it being broken adds something to the article, I think it should just be removed that the one crayon is broken.
